incidents.measured_by: dmesg anon-rss at kill; lower bound (process was killed while still growing)

startup_peak_by_service.incidents: startup peak well above steady peak (1045 vs 631 MiB)
startup_peak_by_service.all_other_services: not measured at start: the data available are steady cgroup memory.peak from a container up about 60 minutes plus the 2026-11-18 daily report, both after the start (a restart resets memory.peak), and no other OOM kill at start is recorded in dmesg

rule: recorded peak of a service = max(steady peak, one start of that service); measure with cgroup memory.peak read after a fresh start (docker compose up --force-recreate <svc>, wait for healthy, read memory.peak); a restart resets memory.peak, memory.events and so oom_kill

report_change.emitted_when: docker RestartCount > 0, with or without previous report, whether or not the count grew

rollback: revert the commit or set DEV_MEM_LIMIT_INCIDENTS; dev compose only, staging and production untouched
residual_findings: scheduled GitHub workflows on this repository start hours late or not at all; the daily measurement had never run by schedule before the manual run 44245690990
